THE ROOM
Arches, lanterns and a bear at your table.

Inside: tiled arches, lanterns and hand-painted plates. Outside: a terrace on the Boulevard, a few minutes from Dubai Opera. And at many tables, a giant teddy bear keeping you company.

ABOUT NAVAT
It started in 2014 with one teahouse in Bishkek.

Today NAVAT runs more than 40 teahouses in Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and the United Arab Emirates. The kitchen is led by brand chef Anvar Babadzhanov. In Dubai we have been on the Boulevard since 2022.
